verdicts.reason: A and B look the same. In both, the dark header bar doesn't span the canvas: there's a strip of cream on the left and a wider one on the right, so it reads as a misplaced block rather than a full-bleed header. Both also leave a large dead gap between the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and the headline. 'Ships late June' floats about 90px below the CTA, so it's separated from the button it belongs to, and the legal text at the bottom is tiny and hard to read.
